summary: Shen Feizhi and Gu Suizhou infiltrate a secret, man-made facility disguised as a cave system. Gu Suizhou, acting shamelessly, forces Shen Feizhi to carry him and later uses a ruse involving feigned heat and pheromones to bypass security guards. They successfully enter an internal office space, where Shen Feizhi struggles to maintain his composure against Gu Suizhou's provocative behavior, eventually threatening him when Gu Suizhou pushes his limits regarding Shen Feizhi's emotional reactions.
